question: In the Republic Day Parade 2022, which state's theme of the tableau was based on Anglo-Abor (Adi) wars?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **Republic Day Parade 2022,** the tableau of Arunachal Pradesh showcased the theme of the Anglo-Abor (Adi) wars.
 
• These wars **were fought by the Adi tribe in Arunachal Pradesh against British colonial forces during the early 20th century,** symbolizing the bravery and resistance of the local communities against imperialism.
 
• These wars were fought primarily in the **early 20th century**, with notable conflicts in **1911-1912**.
 
• The** Adi tribes resisted British attempts to impose control and assert authority over their territory.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term "**Abor" was used by the British to describe the Adi tribe, which is one of the indigenous tribes of Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• **The Adi people are known for their martial traditions and strong sense of independence.**
 
• They lived in the hills along the northern bank of the Brahmaputra River
 
• **First Anglo-Abor War (1858):**
 
 
• This was a punitive expedition launched by the British to curb resistance by the Adi tribes.
 
 
 
• **Second Anglo-Abor War (1911–1912):**
 
 
• The Adi tribes, led by their local chiefs, organized a strong resistance against British forces.
 
• The conflict was triggered by the killing of British officials who ventured into Adi territory without permission.
